title: Scientist Engineer 'SC'
qualification: Aggregate minimum of 65% marks (average of all semesters) or CGPA 6.84 on a 10 point scale. AMIE / Grade IETE candidates should have a minimum of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84 on a 10 point scale in Section B alone.
salary: Scientist Engineer 'SC' is placed at Level 10 of the Pay Matrix, with a pay range of ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500. || The notification does not give the in-hand salary or allowance details. It states that, as per Central Government orders, ISRO employees also receive benefits such as medical facilities for self and dependents, a subsidised canteen, House Building Advance, Leave Travel Concession, the National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme and other social security measures. Career advancement for scientific and technical personnel in ISRO is based on the Merit Promotion Scheme, under which employees are reviewed and promoted to the next grade on merit after a prescribed residency period, without reference to vacancies.
age_limit: The maximum age limit for all three posts is 30 years as on 13.10.2026. || Ex-servicemen, Persons With Benchmark Disabilities and Departmental candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per the Government of India orders issued on the subject from time to time. The notification does not specify the number of years of relaxation. || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.
application_fee: Initially, all applicants have to pay a uniform application fee of ₹750 (Rupees Seven Hundred and Fifty only). A refund is then made according to the category of the candidate.
selection_process: The selection process for all posts consists of a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.
